title: Bounty (staff)
body:
Syntax: bounty create mob <mob vnum> <village> <reward_ryo> <reward_mission_points> <description...>  |  bounty create player <name> <reward_ryo> <reward_mission_points> <description...>  |  bounty remove <id>

Description: Posts or removes a Bingo Book bounty on a mob prototype or a player. IDs are auto-assigned within the target's own village's fixed ID range. Unlike the player-facing 'place bounty', this requires no payment and isn't subject to the same-village restriction.

&D(Staff only.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
